comment: Blessed from the pinned engine, hand-checked to the dollar: cut from wages-and-child-single (wages 48,250, one qualifying child). 3,000 of care expenses on the child, paid to one organization provider: the 20% band (AGI above 43,000) gives a 600 credit on Schedule 3 line 2, inside line 20, so line 24 falls from 1,465 (after the 2,200 child tax credit) to 865. The provider's own fields change no dollar.
